import copy, json, os
from unittest.mock import patch
import numpy as np
import torch
from experiments.natural_quadratic_ranking_20261116 import runner as r, protocol as p

class Scores(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.score = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor([.2,-.3]))
    def forward(self, x):
        return self.score.sigmoid().expand(x.shape[1],2)

model = Scores()
ema = copy.deepcopy(model).requires_grad_(False)
c = p.config('movielens',p.ARMS[0])
opt = p.optimizer(model,c)
x = torch.tensor([[1.,2.,3.,4.],[0.,0.,0.,0.]])
y = torch.tensor([[0.,1.],[1.,0.],[0.,1.],[1.,0.]])
loader = torch.Generator().manual_seed(13022)

ctx = dict(dataset='movielens',seed=2022,epoch=1,batch=2,global_step=2)
warmup = r.train_step(model,opt,ema,x,y,c,ctx,np.arange(4),diagnose=False)

assert set(opt.state[model.score]) == {'step','exp_avg','exp_avg_sq'}
assert opt.state[model.score]['exp_avg'].abs().sum().item() > 0
assert opt.state[model.score]['exp_avg_sq'].sum().item() > 0

    checks = r.smoke_identities(model,opt,ema,loader,device,x,y,np.arange(4),c,ctx,costs)

assert observed.call_count == 7
saved = observed.call_args_list[0].args[4]
assert all(call.args[4] is saved for call in observed.call_args_list)
after = r.state_digest(saved)
assert before == after
final = r.identity_state(model,opt,ema,loader,device)
assert r.state_digest(final) == before
assert int(opt.state[model.score]['step']) == 1
state_id = next(iter(saved['optimizer']['state']))
non_aliasing = {name:opt.state[model.score][name].data_ptr() != tensor.data_ptr()
               for name,tensor in saved['optimizer']['state'][state_id].items()}
assert all(non_aliasing.values())
assert costs['attempted_training_batches'] == 6
identity = dict(status='PASS',fixture='reviewer_Q2_Q3_same_populated_Adam_CPU_fixture',
    checks=checks,warmup_updates=1,optimizer_tensor_keys=sorted(non_aliasing),restore_calls=7,
    restore_spy='wraps actual repaired restore without changing arguments or behavior',
    entire_saved_baseline_sha256_before=before,entire_saved_baseline_sha256_after=after,
    entire_saved_baseline_unchanged=True,final_state_sha256=r.state_digest(final),
    original_step=1,final_restored_step=int(opt.state[model.score]['step']),
    saved_optimizer_tensors_do_not_alias_live=non_aliasing,
    comparison_batches=costs['attempted_training_batches'])

coder_ids = ['01a1e3f5-7f1c-7ad2-9512-5c86d72c033e',
             '01a1e3f5-7f2c-7262-945c-10b1626cfb40',os.environ['CODEX_THREAD_ID']]
review = dict(verdict='PASS',blocking_issues=[],cpu_checks_passed=True,
    source_hash='temporary-in-memory-source-stub',design_bundle_sha256='temporary-in-memory-design-stub',
    reviewer_id='temporary-independent-fixture-reviewer',coder_ids=coder_ids)
